detail: Metric pylon/caps/crosshead, 18 individual stays with sheaths and collars, concrete deck edge/soffit/ribs, east piers, anchors, blue pierced parapets with horn brackets and wires, lantern bollards and drains. Ground remains independently owned by Marine public realm.
walk: Keep structural silhouette, cable sleeves, lanterns and pierced parapets; omit fine tension wires, curved parapet horns and sleeve collars. Pylon and deck meshes are identical to Detail and collapse into shared streaming chains.
district: Separately authored fixed structural envelope from dimensional controls. Retain two pylon legs and pointed caps, crosshead, 18 cables, deck fascia/soffit, piers and anchor masses. Main parapet posts and continuous rails retain open space; fine pickets, horns, wires, lantern cages, collars and bolt heads omitted. Shallow material/joint appearance baked on actual receivers.
projection_groups: Each streaming part projects only its own source meshes; cable receivers use small cages, pylon/slab surfaces use bounded separate cages. Added fine geometry cannot add receiver topology or enlarge atlases.
